verdicts.reason: The two candidates are almost pixel-identical. Each has a sensible left-to-right banner flow, with the quote mark and quote on the left and the can on the right, but both share the same flaws. The brand logo floats in the middle gap with no alignment to anything, so it looks like an orphan. The can is shrunk so far that the SOLSTICE label is unreadable, and its backdrop circle is now a small, fully contained disc instead of a large cropped shape. The quote block is also crammed against the left edge, which leaves the right half underused.
